title: Division of fractions only means sharing
statement: Dividing means sharing a quantity equally among a number of people, so a division by a fraction has no meaning and must be a mistake or a different operation.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: choose the operation for a measurement-division word problem
evidence_patterns.signature: rejects division and multiplies or divides by the wrong number, because 'you can't share among half a person'

example.item: How many 1/2-cup servings are in 3 cups?

evidence_patterns.item_shape: write a word problem for a given fraction division
evidence_patterns.signature: writes a sharing story that does not match the expression, or says it is impossible

example.expected: How many quarter-cups are in three quarters of a cup?
example.response: Three quarters shared between a quarter of a person (or: 'you can't')

discriminators.vs_slip: A slip is one wrong operation choice. The belief is revealed when the learner is asked to model or explain division and only ever produces sharing stories.

vs.math.frac.divide-makes-smaller: Divide-makes-smaller computes an answer with the wrong direction; this belief refuses or reinterprets the operation.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 6.NS.A.1: interpret and compute quotients of fractions

resolved_by.label: CCSS 6.NS.A.1: interpret and compute quotients of fractions
CCSS 5.NF.B.7: divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions
